  Scenario: AC7 A value no read source names is published as the working read with its placeholder and the gap stays open (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a value the consumers need is named by no read source
    When the contract is published
    Then the value is published as the working read of the assumption with its placeholder
    Then the gap stays open and the value is recorded as Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1440; ASM-2535)

  Scenario: AC8 The server release is 1.30 or later for Nexus and Worker Versioning (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the Temporal release declaration in the contract
    When it is validated
    Then it declares the server release 1.30 or later
    Then the release supports Nexus and Worker Versioning and the approved release number is recorded in the environment design

  Scenario: AC9 The contract carries no service short, schema name, topic name or Workbench REST base (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the platform contract document
    When it is validated
    Then it carries no service short, no schema name, no topic name and no Workbench REST base
    Then the platform owns none of them
